Coram : DIPAK MISRA*, R.F. NARIMAN*, D.Y. CHANDRACHUD, A.M. KHANWILKAR, INDU MALHOTRA
Penal Code, 1860: s.497 – s. 198 of Cr.P.C – Offence of Adultery – Whether unconstitutional, being violative of Articles 14, 15 and 21 – Held: (Per Court): s. 497 IPC and s. 198 Cr.P.C. being violative of Articles 14, 15 and 21 of – (Per Dipak Misra, CJI): s. 497 treats women, subordinate to men – The rationale of the provision suffers from absence of logicality of approach and therefore suffers from vice of Art. 14 being manifestly arbitrary – Section 497 also creates invidious distinctions
Decision Date : 27-09-2018 | Case No : WRIT PETITION (CRIMINAL) No. 194/2017 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 5 Judges
